items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: And finally I told him. I said. Look mister.

ctx.x: But he wanted me to play for the people in the hotel. I told him. I said. If I play for the people in the hotel. You ain't have nobody up there. So. We all get about it. Two three months you know. And finally I told him. I said. Look mister. Let me tell you one thing. I said. What you don't know about New Orleans will fill one book. And what you don't know about jazz will fill another book. I said. Now you want Art Hickman to get music up there. You get somebody else. Not me. I said. If I ever go there and play…
